title: Upgrade the Weak Link
goal: Safely access shared data through a Weak pointer handle.
hints: Weak pointers cannot access inner fields directly and must be upgraded to `Rc` first.
`Rc::downgrade` converts a reference to an `Rc` into a `Weak` pointer.
explanation: Weak pointers do not keep data alive. They must be converted to an `Option<Rc<T>>` using `.upgrade()` before reading inner fields. Passing `n.parent` directly to the `?` operator fails with `E0308` because `Weak<Node>` is not an `Option`. Calling `.borrow()` produces `E0599` because `borrow` is a method on `RefCell`. In `main`, the `parent` field expects a `Weak<Node>` handle. It is created using `Rc::downgrade(&p)` rather than cloning the strong `Rc`.
